Import every holiday on or after 1 January of this year, including future years already published in the ICS feed. The feed URL is saved on the group; use Sync (or the console command) later to pull newly published years without reconfiguring.

Compensate expected time: the absence counts as worked time, so the overtime balance stays even (optional auto timesheets if project/activity are set). Reduce expected time: the day’s expected hours are lowered instead — no compensatory booking, the balance does not improve from the absence.
